statement: Entirely fictional, intentionally constructed +10-minute paired-wait demonstration; not observed hospital deterioration.
provenance: Independently constructed for FlowGuard AI. No patient, hospital, academic project, workbook or external dataset inputs.

generator.recurrence: state = (1664525 * state + 1013904223) mod 2^32; output updated unsigned state
generator.sampling: For bound n, reject outputs >= floor(2^32/n)*n; return output mod n.
generator.drawOrder: A day 0..6, slot 0..99: arrival sample(864), then seen-only wait sample(116). B uses no draws.

parameters.arrivalRule: UTC midnight + slot*864 seconds + sample(864) seconds; B = A + 7 days.
parameters.pairingRule: FG-A-NNNNNN and FG-B-NNNNNN share pair number day*100+slot+1, padded to six digits.

serialization.rowOrder: All A then all B; ascending day then slot within each period.
serialization.json: Fixed property insertion order from FG-GENERATOR-1; JSON.stringify(value, null, 2) + LF; no volatile timestamps.
